Best,

EdgeCloud AI

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Looping in Kimberly (marketplace) and Marissa (co-sell/GTM).

Quick answers up front:
- SKU strategy: we typically publish a single SKU per product offering and use the "usage-based" metering mapping when there are API/tokens differences. For your three tiers we recommend: EDGE-API-STND, EDGE-DEDI-POOL, EDGE-PRIVATE-HOST. Kimberly, confirm if those are ok for AMI/entitlement mapping.
- Hero image: PNG, 1200x600 recommended; keep the file under 1MB. We attached a quick hero asset example (aws-marketplace-hero.png).
- Private offer: Marissa will own the PO creation and the commercial terms. 

Sarah — I'll run a short internal readiness checklist and share it back. Can you confirm the pilot customer's expected monthly usage so we can size Dedicated?

Thanks,
Naomi
Senior Partner Lead
Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi/Sarah — tagging a few catalog-specific checks: 

- SKU/AMI: The suggested SKUs look good; please ensure the AMI description includes the exact SKU string so entitlements map on publish. For private offers we use SellerID + SKU mapping.
- Entitlements: For Dedicated Instance we need a clear trial-to-production entitle flow; recommend a 30-day trial SKU with separate AMI tag (EDGE-DEDI-TRIAL).
- Technical meta: we need a short product description (300 chars), a 3-bullet benefit list, and one usage example for the listing. Sarah, can you provide those by EOD tomorrow?

I'll also prepare the packaging CTA and upload a seller-ready manifest to the Drive folder.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Marketplace catalog onboarding & co-sell readiness

Quick technical notes from infra/ops: 

- AMI naming: include the semantic version and SKU; e.g., redwood-llm-1.4.2-EDGE-DEDI-POOL-ami. This prevents mixups across regions.
- Container/AMI size: keep base image <10GB if possible to reduce transfer time for customers.
- Marketplace metrics: include a sampling of 99th percentile latency and token-cost-per-1000 in the product details (helps field and co-sell motions).

Sarah — for the private host option we'll need a contact at the pilot who can accept the security questionnaire; if you have a procurement contact, please introduce.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
